codebase_items.trading_logic: Draws daily opening range box + levels and computes 60-day empirical scorecard (% broken up, down, both, neither; % hitting target multiple before opposite side; avg range points).
codebase_items.entry_exit: Conservative miss accounting (same-bar target + opposite close = miss); closed-bar breakout confirmation; excludes today until completed.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Range start/end server time; Lookback 60 days; Target multiple; colors.
codebase_items.risk_management: Conservative evaluation avoids optimistic intrabar bias.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 979); empirical ORB self-audit dashboard.

codebase_items.title: Fair Value Gaps
codebase_items.author: gepabene
codebase_items.trading_logic: Closed-bar 3-candle FVG detector tracking active/touched/mitigated states (MIT_TOUCH vs MIT_FULL_FILL) and exposing EA-ready iCustom Buffers 0-3 (state, top, bottom, direction).
codebase_items.entry_exit: Bar 0 strictly excluded from detection & mitigation (zero repaint); Buffers 0-3 on candle 3.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: InpMinSizeMode (Points/ATR); InpMinSize 0.0; InpAtrPeriod 14; InpMitigation MIT_FULL_FILL; InpMaxZones 100; InpHistoryBars 3000.
codebase_items.risk_management: No alerts, no DLL, no WebRequest, clean FVGZ_ cleanup.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 859, Rating 1); clean programmatic FVG indicator.

codebase_items.title: Prop Firm Live Daily Breach Line (OrderCalcProfit and iCustom Ready)
codebase_items.author: nzmyrtcn
codebase_items.market_and_timeframe: FX, metals, indices (net open symbol exposure)
codebase_items.trading_logic: Reconstructs 00:00 server baseline by reversing closed deals + entry/exit commissions + 00:00 HWM snapshot, then calibrates exact chart breach price using 2-step OrderCalcProfit() and exposes iCustom Buffers 0-1.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Buffer 0 = active-symbol breach price, Buffer 1 = remaining daily loss $; auto-hides line if flat/hedged/unreachable.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: InpBaseMode (BASE_HIGHEST_OF_BALANCE_EQUITY / Balance); Daily limit; 5s history cache; DPI HUD.
codebase_items.risk_management: Solves cross-pair tick-value drift and intraday closed-commission gaps.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 851, Rating 3); institutional-precision daily breach calculator.

codebase_items.title: After-Exit Analyzer - what price did after you closed: stopped-out trades that later hit TP, profit left after exits
codebase_items.author: hemgaming
codebase_items.market_and_timeframe: Closed positions + post-exit M1 bars (24 market hours)
codebase_items.trading_logic: Reads M1 bars following every closed position (entry/exit reconstructed from deals) to measure post-exit favorable/adverse R-excursion and % of SL exits that later reached original TP.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Diagnoses tight/obvious stops vs premature TP/manual exits; skips multi-entry/partial/reversed positions; estimates sell ask via M1 bar spread; exports CSV.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: History days 90; Symbol/Magic filters (-1 all, 0 manual); Market hours post-exit 24; Experts rows 25; CSV toggle.
codebase_items.risk_management: Warns M1 bars cannot resolve intraminute High/Low ordering; read-only script.
codebase_items.dependencies: Standard MQL5 deal history + M1 bars + CSV FileWrite.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 498, Rating 2); empirical exit-calibration audit script.

codebase_items.title: Trend Regime Indicator
codebase_items.author: Bruno Myrrha
codebase_items.market_and_timeframe: EURUSD D1 / XAUUSD H4 / any symbol & TF
codebase_items.trading_logic: Classifies every bar as Trending Up, Trending Down, or Ranging via ADX(25) and ATR quietness, boxing stretches >=3 bars on chart and plotting directional ADX columns below.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Closed bars calculated once (non-repainting); 1-2 bar flips appear in ADX subwindow without cluttering chart boxes.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: ADX level (25), quiet ATR rule, min box length (3), regime visibility toggles, colors.
codebase_items.risk_management: Clean historical regime segmentation.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 1171, Rating 3).

codebase_items.title: ReliableOutbox (Persistent Telegram/Alert Outbox Library)
codebase_items.author: CodeBase Contributor
codebase_items.trading_logic: Persistent file-backed message outbox queue ensuring Telegram/webhook notifications survive terminal disconnects and retry with backoff.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Queue library; no direct trading.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Queue path, max retries, backoff intervals.
codebase_items.risk_management: Prevents network stalls on OnTick trade execution.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (related to 78293).

codebase_items.title: EA Auditor. What an Expert Advisor really does, from its deal history
codebase_items.author: Jefry Rodriguez
codebase_items.trading_logic: Forensic deal-history audit script profiling true EA behavior: SL usage, trailing behavior, martingale lot scaling, grid/averaging concurrency, active hours, holding time, and red-flag notes.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Read-only forensic auditor; detects hidden martingale/grid/SL=0 tricks without needing .mq5 source.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Magic number, lookback days, report output.
codebase_items.risk_management: Directly detects FPA-style hidden martingale & missing-SL scams from live/demo deal logs.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected; directly complementary to EA_Safety_Check (79623) and FPA Q-1761.

codebase_items.title: EA Safety Check - scan EA source for DLLs, data leaks and martingale
codebase_items.author: Saad Ferdi
codebase_items.trading_logic: On-terminal static security/safety scanner checking .mq5/.mq4/.mqh text for HIGH risk (DLLs, ShellExecute, wininet, FileDelete, hidden char-array URLs, martingale lot mult) and MEDIUM risk (WebRequest, account data leaks, grid, SL=0, shift 0).
codebase_items.entry_exit: Emits DANGER / RISKY / CHECK / CLEAN verdict per file to Experts log & SafetyCheck_report.txt; explicitly notes binary .ex5/.ex4 cannot be audited.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Scan folder MQL5\Files\SafetyCheck\, info flags (expiry/account locks).
codebase_items.risk_management: Zero execution of scanned files.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 173); mirrors Alina Lab static analyzer philosophy.

codebase_items.title: Spread ATR Monitor - current, average and max spread vs ATR
codebase_items.author: Jefry Rodriguez
codebase_items.trading_logic: Compares live, N-tick average, and max spread against closed-bar ATR in points (e.g. XAUUSD M15: 20 pts / 761 ATR = 2.6%), turning warning color above 10% threshold.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Read-only cost-to-volatility indicator.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Tick sample N; ATR period; warning threshold % (10%); panel layout.
codebase_items.risk_management: Prevents entering low-volatility setups with excessive spread drag.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 525, Rating 1).

codebase_items.title: Risk Lot Panel - position size by risk and stop distance
codebase_items.author: Jefry Rodriguez
codebase_items.trading_logic: On-chart lot calculator using broker tick size & loss-side tick value for % Balance, % Equity, or Fixed Money risk (e.g. $100 / 300 pts EURUSD -> 0.33 lots = $99 real risk), warning if min lot exceeds risk.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Read-only display indicator (no buffers, no trading).
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Risk mode (% Bal / % Eq / Money); Risk value; SL points; layout/colors.
codebase_items.risk_management: Always rounds down to volume step.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 559, Rating 1).

codebase_items.title: XAUUSD Hourly Volatility Clock: typical range by hour vs today
codebase_items.author: Pavel Polikarpov
codebase_items.market_and_timeframe: XAUUSD H1 (60-day closed H1 profile; any symbol)
codebase_items.trading_logic: Builds 24-hour closed-bar H1 median (and mean/90th pct) range clock over 60 days, plotting developing current hour vs typical range, busiest/quietest hours, and >=1.5x expansion alert.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Strict no-look-ahead (open hour excluded from medians; requires >=8 samples/hour); objects use HVC_ prefix.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Lookback days (60), highlight hours (10 & 16 server time), expansion alert mult (1.5x).
codebase_items.risk_management: Quantifies exact session volatility rhythms on Gold.
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (Views 6).

codebase_items.title: OvernightIndex_EA (Equity Beta / Overnight Index Drift)
codebase_items.author: CodeBase Contributor
codebase_items.trading_logic: Buys equity index near session close and exits at next session open to harvest overnight index risk-premium drift.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Scheduled intraday close-to-open holding.
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: Entry/exit hours, risk sizing, optional SL.
codebase_items.risk_management: Exposed to equity-index beta & bear-market drawdowns (documented 2022 drawdown ~ -7%).
codebase_items.evidence: CodeBase page inspected (it/code/78628); confirms equity beta dependence (2022: -7%).

codebase_items.title: Previous Day High/Low with First Touch Marker
codebase_items.author: Saad Ferdi
codebase_items.trading_logic: Draws prior D1 high/low across each day and marks the first intraday touch after >=MinDistPct (0.075%) departure with a gold arrow.
codebase_items.entry_exit: Visual touch marker only (PDFT_ objects, no buffers).
codebase_items.indicators_and_parameters: InpDays 10; InpMinDistPct 0.075%; InpAlert true; colors.
codebase_items.risk_management: EMPIRICAL 16-YEAR XAUUSD BACKTEST NOTE: Author tested 2010-2026 (3,637 first touches) on Gold -> breakout won ~50% (no standalone edge), fading was WORSE.
codebase_items.evidence: NEGATIVE EMPIRICAL PROOF (Views 213): 3,637 XAUUSD first touches 2010-2026 yielded ~50% breakouts / worse fades -> confirms raw PDH/PDL touches have zero standalone edge.
